prompt: Our fraud detection team needs a clean, audit-ready prototype notebook that our compliance reviewers can inspect and reproduce months from now. We have a messy draft in notebooks/drafts/fraud_detection_DRAFT.ipynb that a junior engineer threw together — it has data leakage, hardcoded numbers scattered everywhere, and no consistent structure. Please create a new, production-quality prototype notebook called fraud_detection_prototype.ipynb that fixes all of these issues. It should train a logistic regression classifier on the transactions dataset at data/raw/transactions_2023.csv, be fully reproducible, and pass our internal quality gate tool located in the scripts/ folder. The compliance team will run that gate tool against your notebook, so make sure it passes cleanly.
